title: Socket.IO Room Lifecycle
externalChecks: Gate E real-device unsynchronized drift calibration remains EXTERNAL VALIDATION PENDING; Gate H does not finalize drift behavior
instructions: Attach one production Socket.IO server to the existing shared Node HTTP server; do not open a second public port.
Keep same-origin defaults. Do not enable permissive CORS.

Implement only room transport lifecycle: join, explicit leave, state request, snapshot, participant broadcasts, clock request/ack, and transport disconnect marking. Do not implement play/pause/seek intents yet.
On join, RoomService must resolve stable clientId identity and return the existing participantId on reconnect. socket.id is transport identity only and must never become logical participant identity.
A transport disconnect marks the participant disconnected but preserves the participant slot. Do not add the later disconnect-grace timer or room-wide pause policy in this gate.
An explicit watch:leave removes the logical participant slot so another client can join.
watch:state-request returns the latest canonical snapshot; do not replay old playback events.
For watch:clock, capture receive/send timestamps with no await between them and echo the client's t0ClientMs.
Socket errors must be converted to watch:error payloads rather than escaping handlers.
Production shutdown must close the Socket.IO layer before the Gate C probe and HTTP server.
Do not add room creation HTTP endpoints, timeline command handling, clock estimation, scheduled starts, player sync control, buffering policy, chat, Redis, or UI changes.
A task is not complete until pnpm watch:gate exits 0 and the GitHub Watch Together Gate is green.
After Gate H passes, stop. Do not begin Gate I clock-estimator work in the same branch.
